title: 第十五章 我要救我爹第十六章 燕兴楼
content_zh:
九叔道：“小姐，一个时辰到了。”
金雅身体一颤，脸色苍白，“九叔，人马上到……”
“我已经破例了，小姐别让我为难。”九叔面无表情，眼神露出怜悯，“请家法！”
几人抬铁棍过来。
它黑且长，表面暗红斑驳，那是触犯族规者的血迹。
金雅脸色惨白，她当年曾亲眼，见一名叔叔被一棍打断脊背，从此沦为废人。
“师傅等一下！”
柳青大声道，束手退到旁边。
罗冠身影出现。
金雅几乎落泪，急忙行礼，“拜见前辈！”
九叔感知敏锐，目光落下，流露出凝重。
“阁下是谁？”
他想知道，此人是何身份，竟让金雅认为能躲过一劫。
罗冠道：“冲霄境武夫，修有武道秘法，爆发后有与凌云境一战的实力。”他摇摇头，“可越阶而战，对根基有损，随年岁增长气血逐渐衰败，你已在跌境边缘。”
九叔神情一变，“阁下好眼力！”他起身，郑重行礼，“之前多有冒犯，请上座。”
金雅面露尊崇。
前辈就是前辈，依旧这么深不可测，当初一眼看破她的状态，对九叔也是一样。她能察觉到，九叔探究的眼神，却绝不敢多嘴半句，亲自给罗冠倒茶，双手奉上。
今日，她是生是死，就在前辈一念之间。
“好茶。”罗冠喝了一口，“老夫荒野散人，有些炼丹手段，与金雅算是投缘，今日来是要与她做笔交易。”
炼丹师！

九叔心头大震，急忙看向金雅。
她缓缓点头。
乌先生满脸震撼，他想不到金雅，竟暗中结交了一位，实力必然不弱的炼丹师。
若是真的，恐怕他一番谋算不仅落空，还会有大麻烦！
九叔深吸口气，挥手命人抬走家法，“不知阁下尊称？您是贵客，金家私事暂停，不令您久等。”
这是要验证他身份，再做决断。
罗冠道：“你可以叫我四先生。”他起身，“小金，我们去丹房。”
金雅愣了一下才反应过来是叫她，急忙点头，“四先生您请。”
两人离去。
九叔道：“乌先生，多谢你此番传信，金家些许私事，自会处理妥当。”这是要赶人。
乌先生哪肯走，打着哈哈不接话。
九叔皱了下眉，犹豫一下没再驱赶，客厅陷入沉默。
可两人心中，却各自念头翻滚。
丹房外，罗冠站定，随口说了一些药材。
金雅连连点头，命人最快速度送来。
“等一会吧。”
他推门进去。
与第一次炼丹同样的流程，但更加轻松，显然随实力变强，玄龟越发得心应手。
content_en:
Uncle Jiu said: "Miss, the hour is up."
Jin Ya's body trembled and her face turned pale, "Uncle Jiu, people will be here soon..."
"I have made an exception. Miss, please don't make things difficult for me." Uncle Jiu's face was expressionless, with pity in his eyes, "Please help me!"
Several people came over carrying iron bars.
It is black and long, with dark red mottled surfaces, the bloodstains of those who violated the clan rules.
Jin Ya's face turned pale. She had witnessed an uncle's back being broken with a stick, and he had been reduced to a useless person ever since.
"Master, wait a moment!"
Liu Qing said loudly, and stepped aside with her hands tied.
Luo Guan's figure appeared.
Jin Ya almost shed tears and hurriedly saluted, "Greetings, senior!"
Uncle Jiu's perception was sharp, and his eyes dropped, showing solemnity.
"Who is your Excellency?"
He wanted to know who this person was that made Jin Ya think he could escape.
Luo Guandao: "A martial artist in the Sky Realm has cultivated the secrets of martial arts. After breaking out, he has the strength to fight against the Lingyun Realm." He shook his head, "But fighting beyond the level will damage your foundation. As you age, your energy and blood will gradually decline. You are already on the verge of falling."
Uncle Jiu's expression changed, "Your Excellency, you have great eyesight!" He stood up and saluted solemnly, "I have offended you a lot before, please take a seat."
Jin Ya looked respectful.
Senior is senior, and he is still so unfathomable. He saw through her state at first glance, and he did the same to Uncle Jiu. She could sense Uncle Jiu's probing eyes, but she never dared to say a word. She poured tea for Luo Guan herself and served it with both hands.
Today, whether she lives or dies depends on the senior's thoughts.
"Good tea." Luo Guan took a sip, "I am a Sanren in the Wilderness. I have some alchemy skills. I have a close affinity with Jin Ya. I am here today to make a deal with her."
Alchemist!
Uncle Jiu was shocked and looked at Jin Ya hurriedly.
She nodded slowly.
Mr. Wu's face was filled with shock. He never expected that Jin Ya would secretly befriend an alchemist who must be quite powerful.
If it is true, I am afraid that not only will his plan fail, but he will also be in big trouble!
Uncle Jiu took a deep breath, waved his hand and ordered someone to carry the family treasure away, "I don't know your honorific name? You are an honored guest. The Jin family's private affairs are suspended and we won't keep you waiting long."
This is to verify his identity before making a decision.
Luo Guandao: "You can call me Mr. Fourth." He stood up and said, "Xiao Jin, let's go to the alchemy room."
Jin Ya was stunned for a moment before realizing that he was calling her, and nodded hurriedly, "Mr. Fourth, please."
The two left.
Uncle Jiu said: "Mr. Wu, thank you for sending this message. I will handle some private matters of the Jin family properly." This is to drive people away.
How could Mr. Wu be willing to leave? He just laughed and refused to answer.
Uncle Jiu frowned, hesitated for a moment and did not drive away again, and the living room fell into silence.
But in their hearts, their own thoughts were swirling.
Outside the alchemy room, Luo Guan stood still and casually mentioned some medicinal materials.
Jin Ya nodded repeatedly and ordered someone to deliver it as quickly as possible.
"Just wait a moment."
He pushed the door open and went in.
The same process as the first alchemy, but more relaxed. Obviously as the strength becomes stronger, the black turtle becomes more and more handy.
